notes: Hand sanitizer manufacturer cited for CGMP violations (no QU oversight, no release/component testing, no stability program) that allowed release of PROTON ARMOR hand sanitizer batches containing an unacceptable, undisclosed methanol level, and for marketing the product as an unapproved new drug that is misbranded (dangerous to health, false/misleading labeling, undisclosed ingredient, non-conforming with the OTC monograph). Treated methanol formulation/toxicity as a labeling/safety violation rather than microbial/particulate contamination.
